data.one_liner: A pure Dart implementation of the Firebase Admin SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides a pure, idiomatic Dart port of the Firebase Admin SDK. Currently supports admin methods for authentication and the realtime database.
use_when: You need to interact with Firebase Authentication or Realtime Database from a backend or pure Dart environment.
You want to use Firebase admin capabilities using service accounts or default credentials in Dart.
avoid_when: You need official Firebase Admin support for services other than authentication and realtime database.
You are building a standard client-side Flutter app using standard Firebase plugins.
strengths: Written in pure, idiomatic Dart code.
Supports service accounts and default credentials natively.
weaknesses: Limited service support compared to the official Node.js Admin SDK (currently only auth and realtime database).
Requires manual maintenance of credentials and configuration.
data.setup_notes: Requires either a service account JSON file or application default credentials configured via environment variables or gcloud.
